previousRun.reason: iStoreOS ROM curl 8.12.1 to feed 8.22.0 transition leaves curl unusable after automatic libzstd removal; option use_curl 0 did not bypass the actual curl downloader.

rootCause: The lab explicitly requested curl despite its presence in the firmware. Removing the unnecessary request avoids the incompatible curl/libcurl upgrade. Native Dropbear requires /etc/dropbear/authorized_keys.
